Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account and no newsletter, so you can open a game and play straight away.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All of the roughly 9,152 games run in your browser and start instantly, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Many are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category, and games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn the phone sideways. A few older games need a keyboard and mouse, and they say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site only allows family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are collected in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Recently played games, favourites, the light or dark choice and most games' own progress stay on your device and never leave it. If you clear your browser data or play in private mode, they are lost.
A game will not load. What can I do?
Sorry about that. If the page stays blank, tell us which game it was by emailing contact@ilovewebgames.com so we can look into it.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. The rest are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, plus 16 sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I add it to the site?

Yes. Submitting is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/, and a real person plays every submission. An accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
Only the site's own games, the ones made by Door 404. Each has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
